records.rule: The 2014 s.85(2)-(3) minimum-capital restriction applies to public companies. The different issued-capital rule in (4) remains. The awkward payment wording in (1) is held.

records.rule: Baseline issued capital must be at least 25% of share capital, subject to ss.85(3),88. This is not an assertion that all issued amounts must be cash paid at incorporation.
records.quote: less than 25 per cent of the share capital

records.rule: The two-director requirements in s.211(1)-(2) are restricted to public companies by 2014 s.43. The differently worded liability rule in (3) is not expressly amended and its private-company interaction is held.
records.quote: immediately after the word “Every”

records.rule: A secretary is required; the joint director-and-secretary act cannot be satisfied by the same person. Requisite knowledge/experience and public-company qualifications are separate conditions.
records.quote: Every company shall have a secretary

records.rule: The memorandum records name, Sierra Leone office, objects, restrictions, company type and liability, with witnessed signatures. The 2014 amendment repeals the deed-stamping subsection.
records.quote: by repealing subsection (5)

records.rule: Articles are signed, witnessed and consecutively numbered; all or part of Table A may be adopted.
records.quote: Articles of association may adopt all or any

records.rule: The incorporation file includes the actual office, memorandum, officers, subscription/compliance declarations and other required documents; a postal box is not the registered office.
records.quote: but the postal box address or a private bag address

records.rule: The 2014 amendment adds valid director identification/consent and a subscriber-ID declaration.
records.quote: copies of valid

records.rule: Corporate personality starts on the incorporation date in the certificate. The certificate is prima facie evidence.
records.quote: From the date of incorporation mentioned

records.rule: The amended registration-refusal notice uses a reasonable period, not a guaranteed incorporation processing time.
records.quote: within a reasonable period of time

records.rule: Annual returns differ under ss.317-319; completion is within 28 days of the first/only general meeting, with a signed copy forwarded. The 2014 private certificate retains an anomalous s.318 cross-reference, which is held.
records.quote: be completed within 28 days

records.rule: The AGM baseline is annual with a 15-month gap, a first meeting within 18 months and a regulator extension power except for the first. A private written waiver requires auditors and all voting members. Reporting if waived remains held.
records.quote: not more than 15 months shall elapse

records.rule: Keep sufficient accounting/stock records in Sierra Leone and preserve them for six years.
records.quote: period of 6 years

records.rule: Annual IFRS statements have specified private-company content exceptions. The 2014 general audit rule and small-company exception are read with s.302. The inserted exemption literally references subsection (5), not the general rule in (6); its interaction is held.
records.quote: statements of small companies shall not be required

records.section: Rates, bands and thresholds; The base; Examples
records.rule: All small-company conditions apply: private share company, authority-fixed turnover/net-asset caps, no non-citizen member, no Government/public corporation/agency or its nominee as a member, and director ownership of at least 51%. Proportionately adjust the turnover maximum for a company reporting year that is not twelve months under s.302(2). Current monetary caps remain unproved.
records.quote: 51 percent of its equity share capital

records.rule: Statements are laid within 18 months initially and then annually, made up no more than nine months before the meeting; annual-return delivery has the particular unlimited-company exception.
records.quote: with the annual return

records.rule: The 2014 annual-return fine is printed as Le850,000 daily for the company and each officer in default. It is not an authenticated payable 2026 amount; currency and later priority remain held.
records.quote: daily default fine of Le 850,000.00

records.rule: An overseas company establishing a place of business has a one-month baseline registration route with constitution, addresses, officers, resident process recipient and existence evidence. The existing-company transition and later three-month change notice are separate.
records.quote: within one month

records.rule: Potentially primary-tax-liable income triggers a TIN application within 15 days of the relevant activity; an existing holder does not seek another TIN and GST registration remains separate.
records.quote: within 15 days of the commencement

records.rule: The current NIB page refers to one shareholder/director; its linked portal returns the information page. Authenticated forms, fees and completion times are not established.
records.quote: Requires at least one shareholder/director

records.rule: The NRA continues under the 2022 Act rather than relying solely on the 2002 statute.

records.rule: The NRA administers and enforces revenue collection. The 2002 Act is repealed subject to saved instruments.
records.quote: to administer and enforce revenue laws
